cues: Evans dozes in the canoe, and his dream tells us the back story.
Long ago a Spanish galleon ran aground and its gold was buried.
Two hundred years later a Chinese man, Chang-hi, found the gold and reburied it single handed, laying great stress on how safe it was.
Evans and Hooker overheard him by a campfire.
Then the dream jumps to Chang-hi's pigtail in Evans's hand: they took the map by force.
